alternates.summary: Anthropic has officially filed for an IPO, revealing soaring revenue, mounting losses, major enterprise adoption, and an unusual governance structure designed to preserve founder control and its AI safety mission.
alternates.title: Anthropic officially files for its public debut

alternates.summary: Anthropic PBC’s filing for a landmark initial public offering included nearly 100 pages of risk factors, an unusually exhaustive set of disclosures for how the company’s artificial intelligence business could go awry.The list included everything from slowing revenue growth and government regulation to “catastrophic or existential risks to humanity.” The scope of the risks hints at unique challenge public market investors face in gauging the promise and peril of Anthropic’s technology.
alternates.title: Anthropic Warns of Existential Risk, Liability and Slowing Sales

articles.summary: Alexander Embiricos, the OpenAI executive responsible for dots, never wants to have a meeting with someone else's AI agent.
articles.title: How OpenAI turned its coding tools into dots, an always-on personal assistant

articles.summary: Anthropic’s S-1 shows more than half of its $100,000-plus customers now use both the Claude Platform and a first-party app, a cross-selling playbook reminiscent of Amazon that’s making enterprise customers stickier.
articles.title: Anthropic’s IPO filing reveals its strategy for keeping enterprise customers hooked

articles.summary: Anthropic PBC’s initial public offering may give Commonwealth Bank of Australia an opportunity to cash in on a stake it purchased in the artificial intelligence startup more than a year ago and whose valuation has ballooned.
articles.title: Anthropic’s IPO May See CBA Sitting on Multi-Billion Windfall

articles.summary: An AI model said it wouldn’t use any tools, then tried to send something to a server in Beijing anyway, and while researchers say it’s probably a training quirk and not espionage, the whole thing has people asking how much to trust free Chinese AI.
articles.title: Cohere says Alibaba’s Qwen model tried to send a file to Beijing

articles.summary: Less than a month after its mass release of hundreds of manuscripts that it said contained solutions to long-standing mathematics questions, OpenAI is back with three more "major" discoveries in math, computer science, and physics. What's different this time is the choice to have external experts that OpenAI describes as "shepherds" guiding the results in […]
articles.title: OpenAI announces three big science discoveries and a new way to work with academics

articles.summary: With the release of AI agents like Meta's Muse, tech companies are promising consumers that they will start saving them tons of money by finding the best deals. On this episode of the Odd Lots podcast, President and CEO of Groundwork Collaborative Lindsay Owens joins Joe Weisenthal and Tracy Alloway to discuss her think tank's research into agentic commerce and how agents may not be operating in the best interest of the consumer. (Source: Bloomberg)
articles.title: Odd Lots: AI Agents Are Already Changing the Price of Goods

articles.summary: Anthropic has filed its S-1 prospectus with the Securities and Exchange Commission, preparing the company behind Claude to beat OpenAI to the punch with an IPO. In a filing with the SEC, Anthropic said it plans to list on the Nasdaq exchange under the ticker symbol "ANT." The AI company confidentially filed with the SEC […]
articles.title: Anthropic’s IPO filing lays out a plan to ‘revolutionize every area of human endeavor’ with AI

articles.summary: Anthropic PBC’s initial public offering is laying bare the extremes of the multi-trillion-dollar AI boom business model: extraordinary growth paired with uncertainty about demand and the spending required to continue developing the technology. The startup, which publicly filed IPO paperwork on Monday, is poised to be the first major US firm focused solely on building AI software to make its market debut.
articles.title: Anthropic’s IPO Sets Up Defining Moment for Wall Street and AI Boom
